name: Obsidian Obelisk
oracle_text:
This artifact enters tapped.
{T}: Add {C}.
{T}: Add one mana of any color. Spend this mana only to cast a multicolored spell.
blocked_sentences: {T}: Add one mana of any color. Spend this mana only to cast a multicolored spell.

needs.what: a mana_restriction cast-group predicate meaning 'the spell is multicolored' (two or more colors), e.g. {"multicolored": true}, read off the spell's colors in costs.spell_purpose
needs.why_existing_wont_do: mana_restriction groups hold type/subtype names plus the predicates mana_value, x_in_mana_cost, colorless and not_owned (engine/mana.py RESTRICTION_PREDICATES); 'multicolored' is not a type so as a name it matches nothing, and colorless:false admits monocolored spells too. Omitting the restriction (as Pillar of the Paruns currently does) is a strictly better card
